title: De Universiteit van de Toekomst (UU lustrum event, in Dutch)
location: Alex Brenninkmeijerzaal, Johanna Hudiggebouw, Kromme Nieuwegracht 47e
description: Discussion afternoon for the university's 390th anniversary about the future of Utrecht University. Students, policy staff and city residents share perspectives on the university's past, present and future relationship with the city and society. Organised by the Werkgroep Utrechtse Universiteitsgeschiedenis (WUU), with Mette Bruinsma (Descartes Centre). In Dutch. Register by e-mailing wuu@uu.nl.
